title: ChildGuard: A Specialized Dataset for Combatting Child-Targeted Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating baseline machine learning models and Large Language Models (e.g., GPT-4, BERT, RoBERTa) on a newly curated dataset (ChildGuard) of social media posts annotated for explicit and implicit hate speech targeting specific age groups (younger children, pre-teens, and teens) using classification metrics and qualitative error analysis.
